facts.text: pystage-apt is a library to communicate with various Thorlabs APT single-channel controllers and control different types of Thorlabs actuator motors
MotorCtrl manipulates an APT controller channel identified by chan_ident (0x01 for a single-channel controller)
MotorCtrl reads the per-stage Min Pos, Max Pos, Def Min Vel, Def Max Vel, Max Accn, Max Vel and homing parameters from the MG17APTServer.ini section of the detected stage
set_pos refuses (prints and keeps the current position) a target outside the stage configuration Min Pos and Max Pos before sending an absolute move
move_by refuses (prints and sends nothing) a relative distance that would leave the stage configuration Min Pos and Max Pos
set_vel_params requires Def Min Vel <= min_vel < max_vel <= Max Vel and 0 < accn <= Max Accn
The stage unit index is 1 for mm and 2 for degrees; the units property returns 'mm' or the degree sign
Homing direction 1 is forward and 2 is reverse
The homing limit switch is 4 for the forward switch and 1 for the reverse switch
set_home_params requires Def Min Vel < home_velocity < Max Vel
MGMSG_MOT_MOVE_STOP stops any type of motor move on a channel; stop_mode 0x01 stops immediately and 0x02 stops in a controlled (profiled) manner
The upstream serial port opens at 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, one stop bit and RTS/CTS flow control

operator_required.name: position
operator_required.reason: the travel range depends on the mounted stage: MotorCtrl.set_pos compares the target with the per-stage Min Pos and Max Pos read from MG17APTServer.ini (stage/motor_ctrl/__init__.py:281-285), so the operator supplies the range of the installed stage

operator_required.name: maximum_velocity
operator_required.reason: the velocity limit depends on the mounted stage: MotorCtrl.set_vel_params compares against the per-stage Def Min Vel and Max Vel read from MG17APTServer.ini (stage/motor_ctrl/__init__.py:1053-1063), so the operator supplies the limit of the installed stage

operator_required.name: acceleration
operator_required.reason: the acceleration limit depends on the mounted stage: MotorCtrl.set_vel_params compares against the per-stage Max Accn read from MG17APTServer.ini (stage/motor_ctrl/__init__.py:1073), so the operator supplies the limit of the installed stage

operator_required.name: home
operator_required.reason: the upstream homing call takes no speed argument and the class's 0 to 1 scale is a catalogue bound, not a bound of the installed stage; the operator supplies the fraction of the configured homing velocity this site allows

operator_required.name: move_relative
operator_required.reason: a relative move is bounded by the current position and the per-stage Min Pos and Max Pos that MotorCtrl.move_by checks (stage/motor_ctrl/__init__.py:398-403), so the operator supplies the travel range of the installed stage

safe_state.description: stage motion stopped by the APT MOVE_STOP message (stop mode immediate)
